name: Workspace
description: Everything in the workspace is a window: tiled, floating, snapped, maximised, minimised to the dock or popped out.
signature: ({ primary, primaryLabel, dock, scopes, className, }: WorkspaceProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: dock
props.description: Show the dock of open windows (default true).

props.name: primary
props.description: The routed view. Render EntityHeader, WindowFrame.Body and WindowFrame.StatusBar.

props.name: primaryLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the primary window, normally the entity or page title.

props.name: scopes
props.description:
The tenant scope the user is in and how to draw one (R14.4). Windows from another scope
show its chip in their app bar, and the dock groups windows by scope. Omit for a
product without scopes.
